description: Presidential Secretariat - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1933/13 of 21.09.2015 inserting "18 Engineering Council, Sri Lanka" w.e.f. 29.08.2017
categorisation: This gazette notification names President Maithripala Sirisena and details the amendment of ministerial portfolios, specifically adding "Engineering Council, Sri Lanka" to the responsibilities of the "Minister of Mahaweli Development & Environment." It contains both a named individual (the President) and detailed subject matter responsibilities (specific acts and institutions under a minister's portfolio), making it a Hybrid Gazette (Type 3).
